notes: The policy limits destinations (address and port), not URL paths on a host.

Docker embedded DNS at 127.0.0.11 is inside the container network namespace and is not filtered here. A name can still resolve; the connection to the resolved address is what this policy accepts or rejects.
IPv6 egress from the voice container is rejected so an AAAA answer is not an alternate route.
Direct, Smart, and native Live share generativelanguage.googleapis.com:443. Host and port filtering cannot separate those URL paths.
platform.tryb.ai stays disabled until a live connection is observed.

huggingface.co is the only TTS asset host measured on .172. Hugging Face serves large blobs through a CDN or Xet host; none was observed in the container log, and the three cdn-lfs.huggingface.co* names do not resolve at all. A cold-cache download of a large blob may therefore need another entry - measure the redirect target before relying on this list for weights.

entries.purpose: pib.Cloud speech-to-text upload and streaming chat.
entries.evidence: Measured on .172 on 2026-10-18 (PC-75): GET https://api.pib.rocks/health 200, GET /ready 200 {ready:true, model:openai/gpt-oss-120b, provider:groq, upstream:warm}, GET /v1/models 401 with the same error contract as the retired LAN port, and POST /v1/voice-assistant/speech-to-text 400 (same multipart contract). The container resolves api.pib.rocks to 178.105.138.93 through Docker DNS, so resolve:dns has an address at apply time.

entries.purpose: On-device model endpoint. Resolve host.docker.internal inside the container: Docker host-gateway need not equal the attached bridge gateway.
entries.evidence: Measured on .172 on 2026-10-15: host.docker.internal resolves to 172.17.0.1 while the attached bridge gateway is 172.18.0.1. TCP 11434 remains reachable with the corrected bridge-family policy applied.

entries.purpose: Intra-bridge peers: flask-app:5000, rosbridge-ws:9090, pib-blockly-server:2442, and ROS 2 DDS unicast. The bridge gateway address is excluded so this rule is not a full allow to every host port.
entries.evidence: Measured on .172 on 2026-10-15 (PC-45 plan): NetworkMode=multirepo_pib-network, container address 172.18.0.11, shared with the other robot containers. Compose environment names those peers. The subnet prefix was not recorded and is read from Docker at apply time.

entries.purpose: ROS 2 DDS multicast discovery, accepted only when it leaves via the pib-network bridge. It is not forwarded to the LAN.
entries.evidence: The voice service launches ROS 2 nodes (assistant, audio_player, audio_recorder, chat, token_service). On-wire multicast was not observed; this entry exists so discovery is not cut. Unproven until conntrack on .172 shows it.

entries.purpose: Direct generateContent, the Hermes daemon's gemini provider, and the native Live websocket. All three use this host on port 443. Addresses are resolved when the policy is applied.
entries.evidence: Measured on .172 on 2026-10-15 (PC-45 plan): HTTPS to generativelanguage.googleapis.com returned 404, so the host is reachable. Hermes provider is gemini. Code: direct_tool_loop.py PINNED_ENDPOINT and audio_loop.py client.aio.live.connect (google-genai). A live Direct, Smart, or Live flow was not captured in this session.

entries.purpose: TTS assets. audio_player loads the Supertone/supertonic-3 voice styles at container start; without this destination the player cannot load them and speech output breaks.
entries.evidence: Measured on .172 on 2026-10-15 in the recreated container's log: 54 requests to https://huggingface.co (HEAD resolve path 307, GET api/resolve-cache/... 200, 'Fetching 26 files'), and this was the only external host contacted besides the allowlisted ones. Re-measured after the privilege and mount reduction, not carried over from the plan.

entries.purpose: Legacy tryb_api speech route. Disabled because use was not observed. Enabling this entry is what adds the destination; the code path is unchanged.
entries.evidence: Unproven. TRYB_URL_PREFIX=https://platform.tryb.ai is set (PC-45 plan). No connection to platform.tryb.ai was observed from this session, and the legacy route was not exercised.
